# Research robustness checks

*Generated by `scripts/run_robustness.py` on 2026-10-25. Do not edit by hand. Method: [RESEARCH.md](RESEARCH.md); main results: [RESEARCH_RESULTS.md](RESEARCH_RESULTS.md).*

All comparisons use LightGBM. `gain` = variant − Model A on the primary metric (R² or ROC-AUC); `p (corr.)` = Nadeau–Bengio corrected t-test; `q (FDR)` = Benjamini–Hochberg over that table (per setting for sensitivity). The verdict uses q: with dozens of comparisons, a few nominal p < 0.05 are expected by chance.
